## What's Changed
* Support OpenCode v2 plugin API alongside v1 by @stevejkang in ff230d6
* Bump @opentui/core and @opentui/solid to ^0.5.14 by @stevejkang in e28755e

The same package now works on OpenCode v1 and v2. On v2, configure it in `~/.config/opencode/cli.json`:

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/v2/cli.json",
  "plugins": [{ "package": "opencode-tokscale", "options": {} }]
}
```

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/stevejkang/opencode-tokscale/compare/v1.0.2...v1.1.0

## What's Changed
* Run tokscale via bunx or npx when no global install works by @stevejkang in https://github.com/stevejkang/opencode-tokscale/pull/6


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/stevejkang/opencode-tokscale/compare/v1.0.1...v1.0.2
